_note: Global site config and outbound links.
_blogPublic_note: false = blog built but unlisted, noindexed, excluded from sitemap and nav. Flip to true to revive publicly.
_signupForms_note: Active delegate sign-up forms, rendered in array order as one CTA button each on Get Involved. Broadest form first — the Home band does not pick one for the visitor, it routes to Get Involved. Empty the array, or leave only TODO_ urls, and the CTA falls back to the 'Applications opening soon' state — never a dead link. Same rule as incidentFormUrl: keep the published /forms/d/e/<long-id>/ URL, never a /forms/d/<doc-id>/ one.
_signupForms_auth_note: The General Involvement form requires a Google sign-in (verified 2026-08-24 — /viewform redirects to accounts.google.com). Applicants without a Google account cannot submit. Re-check if the team reports drop-off. The Rugby — SMNG form was removed 2026-09-14 when its sign-up period closed.
_recruitmentOpen_note: Drives the Get Involved / home CTA. true = show the signupForms buttons. false = show mailing list signup instead. Single toggle, no code change.
_newsletter_note: The HubSpot form behind /newsletter. None of these are secret. portalId and formGuid are in the form editor's URL (app-na3.hubspot.com/forms/<portalId>/new-editor/<formGuid>). subscriptionTypeId is the 'Monthly Newsletter' subscription the form's consent checkbox is tied to. The page posts to HubSpot from the browser, so .htaccess allows https://api.hsforms.com in connect-src. HubSpot refuses these submissions while the form has CAPTCHA enabled, so keep it off. See MAINTENANCE.md → Newsletter.
_incidentFormUrl_note: Both languages point at the same form — the Google Form is English-only. Must stay the published /forms/d/e/<long-id>/ URL from Send > <>, never a /forms/d/<doc-id>/ one: the doc-id variant leaks the editable document ID into public page source.
_incidentFormAnonymous_note: True because Settings > Responses > 'Collect email addresses' is Off (re-verified 2026-08-18) and the Form does not require sign-in. Re-check after any Form settings change — /report promises anonymity off this flag.
